title: Resumable REST warehouse source: POST-body cursor with resume hook and frozen resume dataclass
answers: How do I build a warehouse source with a POST body cursor?
How do I make a warehouse source resume from a saved cursor?
Why did semgrep fail on my resume config dataclass?
body:
Pattern for cursor-paged, resumable sources (clay is the template; autumn was the model):
- clay/clay.py:clay_source builds a RESTAPIConfig with `JSONResponseCursorPaginator(cursor_path="cursor", cursor_param="cursor", param_location="json")` for APIs that take the cursor in the request body.
- Resume: `resumable_source_manager.can_resume()/load_state()` seeds `initial_paginator_state={"cursor": ...}`. `resume_hook=save_checkpoint` calls `save_state`. `save_state` only stages the cursor; the pipeline commits it after the batch is written.
- clay/clay.py:ClayResumeConfig must be `@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)`. A bare `@dataclass` failed semgrep and the repo invariants.
- source.py subclasses `ResumableSource[Config, ResumeConfig]` and implements `get_resumable_source_manager` and `source_for_pipeline`.
applies: warehouse_sources data_imports sources using ResumableSource and rest_source paginators

search: Resumable REST warehouse sources use `JSONResponseCursorPaginator(cursor_path="cursor", cursor_param="cursor", param_location="json")` for APIs taking cursor in request body. Resume state is seeded via `resumable_source_manager.can_resume()/load_state()` with `initial_paginator_state={"cursor": ...}` and saved through `resume_hook=save_checkpoint` calling `save_state`, which stages the cursor; the pipeline commits after batch write. The resume config class must be `@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)` (bare `@dataclass` fails semgrep and repo invariants). Source class subclasses `ResumableSource[Config, ResumeConfig]` and implements `get_resumable_source_manager` and `source_for_pipeline`. Clay in `products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/sources/clay/clay.py:clay_source` and `ClayResumeConfig` is the template; autumn was the model. Applies to warehouse_sources data_imports sources.
